# Barcode scanner

`zxing-browser-0.2.1.min.js` is the pinned UMD distribution of `@zxing/browser` 0.2.1, downloaded from jsDelivr. It is loaded locally only when the athlete opens the scanner. See the included browser/library license files. No camera image is uploaded; only a decoded numeric product barcode is looked up by CAP.

Source and API: https://github.com/zxing-js/browser/tree/v0.2.1
